workflow_runs.name: CLA Assistant
workflow_runs.display_title: Fix: Add shell quoting instructions for paths with special characters

head_commit.message:
Fix: Add shell quoting instructions for paths with special characters

Resolves #7979

The Codex CLI was generating shell commands with unquoted file paths
containing glob metacharacters like (), [], *, and ?. This caused
zsh (and other shells) to attempt glob expansion, resulting in
"no matches found" errors, particularly affecting Next.js projects
with route groups and dynamic routes.

Changes:
- Updated system prompt to instruct model to quote paths with special characters
- Added quoting guidance to shell tool descriptions (Unix and Windows)
- Added quoting guidance to shell_command tool descriptions (Unix and Windows)

This fix teaches the model proper shell quoting practices rather than
adding an automated escaping layer, which is more flexible and less
error-prone.
